# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Graveyard Shift: Neo-Bike Horde**, a portrait-first browser canvas zombie survival game based on this prompt: Zombie Survival. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around zombie survival play, with competitive, futuristic, multiplayer energy, after work session design, search-friendly hooks like zombie survival, survival, shooter, aesthetics like shonen aesthetic, neon aesthetic, anime aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as sweat lord, rizz. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Mechanics to preserve: lobby role selection, joystick movement, jump, short front action hit/gather, destructible resources with drops, costed barricade/beacon building, rare relic/key hero unlock, zombie bots chasing non-zombies, periodic contact damage, survival age timer, HP/time/resource HUD, death and redeploy flow.

Presentation target: neon anime/shonen cyberpunk commute satire with a redline bike courier focal identity, sweat lord zombie horde, rizz relic reward, compact mobile controls, bold manga-like title, procedural neon road background, meme multiplayer chat, and readable one-thumb portrait UX.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first top-down survival arena with resource gathering, light combat, AI bots, building, and survival timer.
- objective: choose a role, enter the arena, gather resources, fight or evade zombie bots, optionally build barricades/beacons, find the rare key/relic, and survive as long as possible.
- input model: touch joystick movement, action button for frontal attack/gather, jump button, build menu buttons, lobby/restart clicks.
- core loop: start from lobby, spawn world resources/bots, move with joystick, action checks a short front hit area, resources drop inventory, zombies chase non-zombies, age/time increases, HUD updates, death exits to restart screen.
- fail/friction state: HP reaches zero from zombie attacks or age reaches max; resource/build denial if costs are unmet; hero role remains locked until key found.

## Protected Mechanics
- Role stats, joystick movement, jump gravity, frontal action reach, resource hp/drops, build costs, rare key unlock, bot chase radius/damage cadence, age timer, death/restart, HUD counters.

## Remix Blueprint
Zombie Survival. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around zombie survival play, with competitive, futuristic, multiplayer energy, after work session design, search-friendly hooks like zombie survival, survival, shooter, aesthetics like shonen aesthetic, neon aesthetic, anime aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as sweat lord, rizz. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The canonical rebuild is **Graveyard Shift: Neo-Bike Horde**: the same survival arena reframed as a satirical after-work neon zombie survival queue where a redline bike courier survives undead commuters, gathers noodle/battery supplies, deploys barricades, and chases the rizz relic to unlock the Redline Warden.
